title: Away from home
summary: Reach your home network from your phone or PC when you are out.

items.title: Reach home from anywhere
items.text: A new Away from home card in Admin → Network gives your phone and PC a private WireGuard link to the home network. Scan a QR code in the WireGuard app, then SSH to the server or open Roost's Admin when you are out. Only home traffic goes through the link.
